# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. combine_parts in geometry
  - Files: presstoshape/geometry/booleans.py, tests/geometry/test_booleans.py
  - `Mode` literal, mode → pathops op table, `combine_parts(parts)` folding bottom to top from the first part; remove `boolean()` once its caller moves (task 4)
  - Purpose: one ordered-parts evaluation shared by destructive booleans and future Composites
  - _Leverage: existing `_to_skia` / `_from_skia`_
  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer with computational geometry experience | Task: Add combine_parts per design.md (geometry/booleans.py) with tests for each mode, non-add first part, empty results, non-overlapping intersect, triple-overlap exclude, and parity with the existing union/difference tests | Restrictions: Qt-free, pathops only; convert each outline once; speaking names; say "type" not "kind" | Success: tests pass. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. split_regions in geometry
  - Files: presstoshape/geometry/booleans.py, tests/geometry/test_booleans.py
  - Connected areas of a simplified outline with their holes (even/odd containment depth; hole → smallest containing outer)
  - Purpose: divide pieces and later per-region handling
  - _Requirements: 3.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer with computational geometry experience | Task: Add split_regions per design.md; tests: two disjoint squares → 2 regions, square with hole → 1 region / 2 contours, island inside hole → 2 regions | Restrictions: Qt-free, pathops only | Success: tests pass. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. divide in geometry
  - Files: presstoshape/geometry/booleans.py, tests/geometry/test_booleans.py
  - Incremental divide returning `(segments, top_index)` pieces, split into regions, slivers under MIN_PIECE_AREA dropped
  - Purpose: geometry for Path → Divide
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.6, NFR Performance_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer with computational geometry experience | Task: Implement divide per design.md (incremental algorithm); tests: two overlapping squares → 3 pieces with correct top indices, ring cut by a bar → disconnected pieces separated, identical squares → 1 piece, slivers dropped, 20 overlapping shapes finish quickly | Restrictions: Qt-free; no exponential subset enumeration | Success: tests pass. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. Boolean operations module
  - Files: presstoshape/editing/operations/booleans.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/paths.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/__init__.py, tests/editing/test_booleans.py, tests/editing/test_paths.py
  - Move combine out of paths.py; combine via combine_parts for union/difference/intersection/exclude; divide_selection; `_replace_with`; empty-result and pathops-failure messages; register path.intersection/exclude/divide
  - Purpose: undoable commands for all five operations
  - _Leverage: existing combine z-order logic, queries.can_combine, _document.new_id_
  - _Requirements: 1.1–1.3, 2.1–2.3, 3.1, 3.3–3.5, 4.4–4.6, 5.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer working in the session/operations architecture | Task: Create operations/booleans.py per design.md; move union/difference tests from test_paths.py to tests/editing/test_booleans.py and add intersection, exclude, divide tests (styles, z-order, selection, single undo step restoring ids/order, empty messages, disabled for fewer than 2 outlines or text-only, undo labels); delete geometry.boolean() if unused | Restrictions: geometry runs before session.edit so a pathops error changes nothing; one undo step per command | Success: full suite green, architecture test passes. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. Keymap, menu, tool strip and icons
  - Files: presstoshape/views/keymap.py, scripts/generate_icons.py, presstoshape/icons.py, presstoshape/assets/icons/*.svg
  - Bindings for path.intersection (Ctrl+*), path.exclude (Ctrl+^), path.divide (Ctrl+/); Path menu and tool strip layouts; Tabler icons layers-intersect-2 / layers-difference / layers-intersect
  - Purpose: make the commands reachable
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: PySide6 developer | Task: Extend keymap and icons per design.md; regenerate icons with `uv run --group dev python scripts/generate_icons.py`; QTest scratch check of every shortcut and tool strip button offscreen and on desktop GL; if Ctrl+^ doesn't fire on the user's layout (dead key), add Ctrl+Alt+X as second Exclude binding and report it | Restrictions: Icons via icon_engine only; keymap test must pass | Success: screenshot shows extended menu/tool strip; shortcuts verified. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 6. Docs and final check
  - Files: README.md, FAQ.md, .spec-workflow/steering/product.md, CLAUDE.md (only if a convention changed)
  - Feature lists mention all five booleans; run full suite, screenshot, visual check of a divided rect+ellipse
  - Purpose: keep docs truthful
  - _Requirements: All_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec full-booleans, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Developer focused on docs and verification | Task: Update feature lists (hedged wording in README/FAQ), verify per design.md Testing Strategy | Restrictions: Delete scratch scripts and crops afterwards, one command per deletion | Success: docs updated, all checks pass. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._
